# Examplesite Style Guide

> SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — see `tests/fixtures/legacy_pipeline/README.md`

## Headline capitalization

- **Use Title Case**: Each Significant Word Capitalized
- Articles (a, an, the), short prepositions (in, on, at, for, to), and short conjunctions (and, but, or) are lowercase unless first or last
- Example: "Best Laser Pointer Under $100: A Real-World Buying Guide (2026)"

## List formatting

- **Complete sentences end with a period**; short phrases don't
- Phrase example: `450nm blue laser diode`
- Sentence example: `Blue lasers deliver higher raw power at the same price point.`

## Numbers

- **Arabic numerals by default**: 5mW, 100 meters, 3 safety classes
- Spell out or rephrase when starting a sentence ("Five milliwatts is...", not "5 is...")
- Always use Arabic numerals for technical specs

## Punctuation

- English articles use English (half-width) punctuation
- Don't mix Chinese and English full-width/half-width punctuation in the same paragraph
- Em-dashes use spaces around them: `word — word`, not `word—word`
- Curly quotes are fine, but straight quotes are also acceptable

## Code and inline technical terms

- Use backticks for file names, command names, function names: `seo-ops`, `init_db()`
- Use bold for UI labels: **Settings**, **Cancel**
- Spell out acronyms on first use: "FDA (Food and Drug Administration)"

## Tables

- Header row uses bold columns
- Align numbers right: `| 1,234 | 12.5% | 4.7 |`
- Align labels left
- Don't use tables for content that fits in 2-3 sentences

## Links

- Always use Markdown link format `[label](url)`
- Open external links in a new tab is OK but not required
- Internal links should be relative: `[our settings page](/settings)`
- No "click here" or "read more" as anchor text
